problems.title: Climbing Stairs
problems.description: You are climbing a staircase with n steps. Each time you can climb 1 or 2 steps. Return distinct ways to top.

starterTemplates.python:
import sys
def climb_stairs(n: int) -> int:
    if n <= 2: return n
    a, b = 1, 2
    for _ in range(3, n + 1): a, b = b, a + b
    return b
if __name__ == "__main__": line = sys.stdin.read().strip(); print(climb_stairs(int(line)))
